summary: Sphere 3D Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a September 8, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement for a $5.0 million private placement of 1,666,661 units at $3.00 per unit, each unit comprising one common share and one five-year warrant exercisable at $3.50, closing September 11, 2026. Insiders, including the Chairman and CEO, subscribed 333,332 units (~$1.0 million). Proceeds fund working capital; full cash exercise would add roughly $5.8 million. Purchasers accepted a six-month lock-up with customary beneficial ownership caps of 4.99% to 19.99%. This is a routine registered-direct-style financing, not a special situation.
